speaker: THE KEEPER'S TALE
title: The shore that remembered
text: The sea gave you back at sundown. No ship. No name. Only a warm stone closed inside your hand. Above the shore, the lighthouse stood dark for the first time in a hundred years. And somewhere in that darkness, something had begun to wake.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: A small, stubborn light
text: Easy now, traveller. You washed up with an ember from our beacon. That means the island chose you, though I imagine you would have preferred a boat. We can mend the light together. First, gather two pieces of driftwood and two copper ore from the shore. The old forge still has a little fire in it.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: Something worth holding
text: Good. Feed the wood and copper to the forge. A blade need not be beautiful to keep you alive. Yours will do both. I have left a sword and dagger pattern on the anvil. Make them, then try each against the training effigy beside the ruins.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: Steel has two voices
text: The sword has reach, and a sweep that catches more than one enemy. The dagger is quick. Stay close, strike, and move before the answer comes. Land three blows with each. When you are ready, bring that ember to the blue rune well. There is more to you than steel.

speaker: THE VOICE IN THE EMBER
title: The other fire
text: You remember this warmth. A hearth. A hand in yours. Then the sea took the memory away. Hold the ember over the well. Let the light find a shape. Cast three bolts at the effigy. Your focus will return between spells. It always does.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: What the tide brought in
text: The ward is breaking. Three drowned shades have crossed into the northern garden. Defeat them and collect the embers they leave behind. Watch the ground for their strikes, and dodge aside. If you need strength, catch a silverfin by the jetty and cook it at my fire.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: The last watch
text: Those were only echoes. The Hollow Warden waits at the lighthouse. Once, he kept this island safe. Now he has forgotten everything but the watch. Break the shadow holding him. When the circle beneath him burns red, get clear. When he falters, strike. I will keep a fire for you.

speaker: THE HOLLOW WARDEN
title: A watch, ended
text: A light. I had forgotten what it looked like. Take the embers to the beacon, traveller. Tell Edda the sea was quiet, at the end. And when you leave this island, leave a little of your warmth behind.

speaker: EDDA · KEEPER OF THE LIGHT
title: Every journey begins with a shore
text: Look at that. A hundred ships will find their way home tonight, and none of them will know your name. That is how the best stories begin. Rest here a while. Fish, practise, watch the water. The world beyond the mist can wait until morning. Welcome to Emberwake, keeper of the first flame.
